mcat_description.short: Prefabricated walls are factory-manufactured wall panels and systems — including sandwich panels (PUF/EPS core with metal cladding), precast concrete panels, AAC panels, and compound wall systems — supplied as ready-to-install building components for industrial, commercial, and residential construction in India.
mcat_description.long: Prefabricated walls encompass a range of off-site manufactured wall systems designed for rapid on-site assembly, including insulated sandwich panels (PUF, EPS, or rock wool core with PPGI/GI metal facing), precast reinforced concrete wall panels, AAC/Aerocon lightweight panels, gypsum board partitions, and precast compound/boundary wall systems. In the Indian B2B market, these products are governed by BIS standards including IS 15916 (prefabricated concrete), IS 15917 (mixed/composite construction), and IS 13831 (prefabricated buildings code of practice). Buyers evaluate panels primarily on core material, panel thickness, thermal insulation performance, fire rating, and structural load-bearing capacity. The category serves industrial warehouses, cold storage facilities, commercial buildings, affordable housing projects, and boundary/compound wall applications across India.

market_context: The Indian prefabricated wall panel market is driven by urbanisation, the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) affordable housing programme, and rapid growth in industrial corridors and logistics parks. Two independent market research sources (Market Research Future, IndexBox 2026) confirm that the residential sector leads by volume nationally, while the industrial segment (factories, warehouses, cold storage, cleanrooms) is the fastest-growing application and the dominant buyer type on B2B platforms. Key material types in the Indian market include concrete panels (largest share by material), metal-faced sandwich panels (PUF/EPS/rock wool core), AAC/Aerocon panels, and LGSF systems. Relevant BIS standards include IS 15916:2011 (prefabricated concrete buildings), IS 15917:2010 (mixed/composite construction), and IS 13831 (code of practice for prefabricated buildings). The market is projected to grow at approximately 4.4–6.2% CAGR through 2035, supported by government infrastructure spending and sustainability mandates. Key Indian market players include Tata Steel (sandwich panels), EPACK Polymers, and Shree/JSW Cement (precast). Buyer vocabulary on IndiaMART includes PUF panels, EPS panels, Aerocon panels, and precast compound walls — call data confirms PUF panels and insulated sheets as dominant buyer enquiry types.
